description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver, update Spring datasource and Hibernate configuration, convert Oracle-specific SQL and BLOB storage to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents (bytea for photo data), and use managed identity instead of plaintext database credentials.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the ojdbc8 Oracle JDBC driver dependency with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update spring.datasource.driver-class-name, datasource configuration, and spring.jpa.database-platform/Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Migrate schema definitions and convert Oracle BLOB columns used to store photo binary data to PostgreSQL bytea. Convert Oracle-specific SQL queries in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax. Update application.properties and application-docker.properties datasource URLs for the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint, and replace plaintext database credentials with managed identity authentication.
